nodes.label: RAG Retrieval Strategy (Hierarchical Auto-Merging)
nodes.rationale: Documents are chunked into parent nodes (PARENT_CHUNK_SIZE tokens) and child nodes (CHILD_CHUNK_SIZE = PARENT // 4); only child vectors are stored in Qdrant while parents live in docstore.json. Query time: embed → top-K child similarity search → AutoMergingRetriever promotes child groups to parent when >= AUTOMERGE_THRESHOLD fraction of siblings retrieved → SentenceTransformerRerank → top-N to LLM. Embed model is unloaded from Ollama before the LLM loads so both fit in limited VRAM by running sequentially.

nodes.label: Incremental Indexing (Qdrant as single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: On each run the indexer scrolls Qdrant once to read back each indexed file's file_path and content_hash payloads instead of maintaining a manifest file, so Qdrant itself is the single source of truth and cannot fall out of sync with a sidecar file. New/changed docs are re-embedded; deleted docs are cleaned up; unchanged docs are skipped entirely, avoiding needless embedding calls. Config drift (chunk sizes, embed model) is detected via the index_meta version stamp and triggers an automatic full rebuild.
